evidence.ppr_source: recalculated from raw nflverse weekly regular-season component stats; no precomputed fantasy-points field used
evidence.selection: fantasy-relevant players selected only from pre-target player-history projections using the current 162-player position counts
evidence.walkforward: for each target season, shrinkage strength was tuned only on the immediately preceding season and frozen before evaluation

interpretation.reason: The broader leakage-safe multi-year test found no target season in which generic position-average shrinkage improved both MAE and RMSE. Player-specific history should not be automatically pulled toward a broad positional mean. Bayesian updating may still be useful when priors are based on validated role/cohort similarity, rookie/no-history cohorts, or current evidence updates.

allowed_next_tests: current role and usage update backtest
